version_scheme: YYYY.MM.DD product release. Do not use PathTogether package.json 0.1.0 (test package) as the product version.

zh: 修复英文示例切片名称与长名称显示。
Demo AI 导航单次上限提升至 100 步。
加强个人标注与分享链接的数据隔离，修正作者人数统计。
优化矩形与箭头绘制，支持撤销操作。
支持右键添加视野和标注到会话。
从标注开始分析时自动附带全片概览。
en: Fixed English sample slide names and long-name display.
Increased the demo AI navigation limit to 100 steps per run.
Improved annotation and share isolation and corrected author counts.
Improved rectangle and arrow drawing and added undo support.
Added context-menu actions to attach a view or annotation to a conversation.
Added a whole-slide overview when starting an analysis from an annotation.

zh: 改进 AI 观察、停止/继续与当前视野上下文。
首页登录弹窗与演示在手机和语言切换下更稳定。
支持测试申请、审核与激活通知。
修复百度网盘导入相关问题。
en: Improved AI observations, stop/resume pairing, and current-view context.
Stabilized the homepage login dialog and demo on mobile and language switch.
Added test-application submission, review, and activation notices.
